name: Dracon

supportingSources.locator: Tables 1–3, 14, 44, 46, 53, and 60 and Chapter 9 combat rules
Dracon. AC 5 and Large body only in this build.

sourceDistinctions: Use the CGR1 player class rules. The companion creature's six racial Hit Dice, THAC0 and armor loadout do not carry over.
Core PHB Strength adds 1 to each PC claw hit. Use routine shield fallback and defense by facing.

name: Giff

supportingSources.locator: Tables 1–3, 14, 44, 46, 53, and 60 and Chapter 9 combat rules
Giff. Base movement 6 only in this build.

sourceDistinctions: CGR1 player head-butt replaces the creature entry's attack sequence. This build treats 2d6 as fixed racial damage and applies normal Strength to the melee attack roll.
The title is an original NPC role, not a mechanical kit.

name: Grommam

supportingSources.locator: Tables 1–3, 14, 44, 46, 53, and 60 and Chapter 9 combat rules
Grommam. Ground and tree movement only in this build.

sourceDistinctions: The original CGR1 species prose is more generous than Chapter 5's Ambidexterity description. The playable build uses the explicit lineage waiver, while the smaller off-hand requirement remains in force.
The worked fighter uses the original male ability adjustment line. The profile preserves both printed lines.

name: Hurwaeti

supportingSources.locator: Tables 1–3, 14, 44, 46, 53, and 60 and Chapter 9 combat rules
Wiggle (Hurwaet), first column. Ground and swim movement only in this build.
Chapter 11, second-level wizard spell Fog Cloud. Stationary fog bank, wind and visibility rules.

sourceDistinctions: The core chapter gives the bank duration per caster level, and CGR1 assigns no caster level to the racial use. For a runnable convention, use 3rd level, the first wizard level with second-level spell access, for seven rounds. The fixed CGR1 dimensions supersede the spell-derived area.
The playable profile borrows the normal spacefaring Hurwaet's movement, not the salt or swamp creature's values.
